test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : VSQ :: OLJ : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is

Given 

# : VSQ :: OLJ : %

Option 1) # = UZT, % = QMG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0f0fe308260b0169da8dbf29315770e247c5614ee506ea8de6dacff328c6154.png] 

Does not follow the same pattern.

Option 2) # = IQT, % = VCG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/961c9e403d212db6fd8cba520225684f7701aba5750b25c74a7d529c91f98f55.png] 

Does not follow the same pattern.

**Option 3) # = YVT, % = LIG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58803f797bd6a35cb820d09b2423e6debf7a31667bd79c8d9fe8391b6f1c9b71.png] 

**Follow the same pattern.**

Option 4) # = YOZ, % = LOQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c628069e18e51ce97ce0bf6d2fc2f5124d0195fabb9d923af2133a0b216efcc6.png] 

Does not follow the same pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
